papers.title: From 1D Benchmarks to Complex 3D Geometries: Can Agents Reliably Specify Problems for Automated PDE Simulation?
papers.translated_title: 从一维基准到复杂三维几何：智能体能否可靠地为自动化偏微分方程模拟指定问题？
papers.author: Akshat Jani
papers.summary: Turning an engineering request into a simulation requires consistent geometry, physics, boundary conditions, and numerical settings. Recent agent-assisted systems automate simulation setup, but successful execution alone does not establish whether the specification preserves the intended problem or correctly handles missing information. We study whether agents can reliably construct complete executable JSON specifications for automated geometry creation, meshing, PDE solving, and result export. Our workflow combines model extraction with deterministic scientific and capability checks, explicit clarification, and validated local patches that preserve unrelated accepted fields. We evaluate specification correctness, execution completion, and numerical verification separately. On 120 template-related requests, the full workflow achieves 98.3% correct first-turn specification and decision outcomes, compared with 92.5% for schema-assisted single shot and 82.5% for model-only: gains of 5.8 and 15.8 percentage points, respectively. It makes no false-ready decisions among the 42 requests requiring clarification or rejection. Component ablations identify contributions from scientific checks and conditional repair. Separate downstream studies cover 1D, 2D, and 3D steady and unsteady, linear and nonlinear problems, including flow and elasticity with complex three-dimensional wing geometries. A 30-case gallery demonstrates automated execution from retained JSON specifications, while 9 of 12 selected live user-to-results tests achieve joint specification, execution, export, and numerical-reference success (75.0%). These results support traceable, engineer-reviewed simulation assistance within the tested scope, while fresh-response regressions identify consistency as a priority for further improvement.
papers.translated_summary: 将工程请求转化为仿真需要一致的几何、物理、边界条件和数值设置。近期的智能体辅助系统实现了仿真设置的自动化，但仅成功执行并不能确定规格是否保留了预期问题或是否正确处理了缺失信息。我们研究智能体能否可靠地构建完整的可执行 JSON 规格，用于自动化几何创建、网格划分、PDE 求解和结果导出。我们的工作流将模型提取与确定性科学和能力检查、显式澄清以及保留无关已接受字段的经过验证的局部修补相结合。我们分别评估规格正确性、执行完成度和数值验证。在 120 个模板相关请求上，完整工作流实现了 98.3% 的正确首轮规格与决策结果，而模式辅助单次执行为 92.5%，仅模型为 82.5%：分别提升 5.8 和 15.8 个百分点。在 42 个需要澄清或拒绝的请求中，它没有做出任何错误的就绪决策。组件消融识别了科学检查和条件修复的贡献。独立的下游研究涵盖一维、二维和三维稳态与非稳态、线性与非线性问题，包括具有复杂三维机翼几何的流动和弹性问题。一个 30 案例的图库展示了从保留的 JSON 规格进行自动化执行，而在 12 个选定的实时用户到结果测试中，有 9 个实现了规格、执行、导出和数值参考的联合成功（75.0%）。这些结果支持在测试范围内提供可追溯、经工程师审查的仿真辅助，而新响应回归将一致性确定为进一步改进的优先事项。

papers.title: Input-dependent Neuromodulation Enhances Mixed-Signal Neuromorphic Hardware
papers.translated_title: 输入依赖的神经调制增强混合信号神经形态硬件
papers.author: Aashman Mehta
papers.summary: Gating mechanisms allow a fixed neural network to adapt its computation to the current input by dynamically modulating its effective parameters. In the brain, neuromodulation uses this principle to move neural circuits between dynamical regimes, and deep learning exploits input-dependent gating, e.g., in gated recurrent networks and self-attention. Input-dependent modulation has also recently been shown to improve spiking neural networks, with particularly strong benefits in small, parameter-limited ones. This makes neuromodulation especially promising for neuromorphic processors at the edge, where area, memory and energy budgets constrain network size, while circuit physics limits parameter precision. Here we demonstrate input-dependent, within-trial neuromodulation of a spiking recurrent neural network on a mixed-signal neuromorphic processor. An off-chip modulator reads the on-chip network's input and activity and adjusts its population-level gains while the chip's analog circuits compute with the physics of the silicon. Neuromodulation raises binary spoken-digit classification accuracy by $+17.3 \pm 10.4$ percentage points, tested across five hardware network instantiations.
papers.translated_summary: 门控机制使固定的神经网络能够通过动态调节其有效参数，使计算适应当前输入。在大脑中，神经调制利用这一原理在动态机制之间切换神经回路，而深度学习则利用输入依赖的门控，例如在门控循环网络和自注意力机制中。最近的研究还表明，输入依赖的调制能够改善脉冲神经网络，尤其是在参数受限的小型网络中效果显著。这使得神经调制对于边缘端的神经形态处理器尤为有前景，因为在边缘端，面积、内存和能量预算限制了网络规模，而电路物理特性限制了参数精度。在此，我们展示了在混合信号神经形态处理器上对脉冲循环神经网络进行输入依赖的试验内神经调制。一个片外调制器读取片上网络的输入和活动，并在芯片的模拟电路利用硅的物理特性进行计算的同时，调节其群体水平的增益。在五个硬件网络实例上测试，神经调制将二值语音数字分类准确率提高了 $+17.3 \pm 10.4$ 个百分点。

papers.title: Rome Wasn't Built in One Turn: Replay-Grounded Reward Signals for Long-Horizon Freeciv Agents
papers.translated_title: 罗马不是一回合建成的：基于回放的奖励信号用于长时程Freeciv智能体
papers.author: Yanchen Liu
papers.summary: Training language-model agents to play long-horizon strategy games is hard because deterministic feedback is sparse and often arrives only at the end of a game. In-game scores can offer dense signals, but they do not reliably predict future outcomes: in 8-68% of position pairs across eight strategy games, the higher-scoring position leads to the worse outcome. We term this phenomenon scoreboard traps. In Freeciv, an open-source turn-based empire-building game where several players manage units, cities, and diplomacy over hundreds of turns, we look into better reward signals for gameplay agents. To facilitate this, we build CivHarness, an open system that saves current game states, branches on different decisions, and replays the game to future turns to provide measurable long-horizon feedback from saved positions. We use CivHarness to train CivTelescope, an LLM Judge that predicts which one of two game positions will yield the better outcome. On scoreboard-trap pairs, CivTelescope is 1.3-2.0 times more accurate than off-the-shelf language models, and it generalizes to new game starts, later turns, and unseen rules. We then train a Freeciv gameplay agent with CivTelescope as a dense reward, and call this recipe CivMarshmallow. When used in the middle stage of the game where scoreboard traps are common, CivMarshmallow reaches an average training phase gain of 8.94 points, 77% more than the best baseline, the end-of-game reward. Over the full 120-turn game, CivMarshmallow uses a hybrid reward that starts from the scoreboard or the end-of-game reward and shifts to CivTelescope as the game advances; this hybrid reward scores highest among the rewards we compare.
papers.translated_summary: 训练语言模型智能体玩长时程策略游戏很困难，因为确定性反馈稀疏，且往往只在游戏结束时才出现。游戏内得分可以提供密集信号，但并不能可靠地预测未来结果：在八款策略游戏中，8%至68%的位置对里，得分更高的位置反而导致更差的结果。我们将这一现象称为记分板陷阱。Freeciv是一款开源的回合制帝国建设游戏，多名玩家在数百个回合中管理单位、城市和外交，我们在这款游戏中寻找更适合游戏智能体的奖励信号。为便于实现这一点，我们构建了CivHarness，这是一个开放系统，可保存当前游戏状态、在不同决策上分支，并重放游戏到未来回合，从而从保存的位置提供可度量的长时程反馈。我们使用CivHarness训练CivTelescope，这是一个LLM评判器，用于预测两个游戏位置中哪一个会带来更好的结果。在记分板陷阱位置上，CivTelescope的准确率是现成语言模型的1.3至2.0倍，并且能泛化到新的游戏开局、更晚的回合和未见过的规则。随后，我们以CivTelescope作为密集奖励训练了一个Freeciv游戏智能体，并将这一配方称为CivMarshmallow。在记分板陷阱常见的游戏中期使用时，CivMarshmallow达到平均训练阶段增益8.94分，比最佳基线（游戏结束奖励）高出77%。在完整的120回合游戏中，CivMarshmallow使用一种混合奖励，从记分板或游戏结束奖励开始，并随着游戏推进转向CivTelescope；在我们比较的奖励中，这种混合奖励得分最高。

papers.title: Instrumental Transfer Learning for Solution Operators
papers.translated_title: 面向解算子的工具性迁移学习
papers.author: Tongyu Li
papers.summary: Data-driven learning for the solution operator of a differential equation has broad scientific importance, but observations from a target system are often scarce and costly to collect. Related source systems may provide abundant observations under similar physical conditions, whereas even small changes in the governing equation can induce complex changes in the solution operator, making naive data pooling ineffective. We propose a structured transfer learning method that accounts for unknown sparse differences in the governing equations from a known library of candidate terms. Using the resolvent identity and a whitened instrumental variable approach, we construct unbiased source estimating equations for the target operator. Building on these equations, we develop a three-stage estimator that consists of a target-only ridge pilot, source-wise sparse calibration, and a projected refit designed to remove the leading calibration error inherited from the pilot. An iterative recalibration scheme further reduces the remaining error. We establish non-asymptotic prediction bounds showing when transfer achieves the pooled all-source rate, together with minimax lower bounds that characterize both rate optimality and fundamental identifiability limits under common shifts. Simulations and an electronic band-pass filter application demonstrate clear gains over target-only learning, naive pooling and existing transfer methods.
papers.translated_summary: 数据驱动学习微分方程的解算子具有广泛的科学重要性，但目标系统的观测往往稀少且采集成本高昂。相关源系统可能在相似物理条件下提供丰富的观测，然而即使控制方程发生微小变化，也可能引起解算子的复杂变化，使得简单的数据合并无效。我们提出一种结构化迁移学习方法，该方法从已知的候选项库中处理控制方程里未知的稀疏差异。利用预解恒等式和白化工具变量方法，我们为目标算子构造无偏的源估计方程。基于这些方程，我们开发了一个三阶段估计器，包括仅目标岭回归试点、逐源稀疏校准，以及一个投影重拟合，旨在消除继承自试点的首要校准误差。迭代重校准方案进一步减小剩余误差。我们建立了非渐近预测界，表明迁移何时达到合并全源速率，并给出极小极大下界，刻画了共同偏移下的速率最优性和基本可辨识性极限。模拟和电子带通滤波器应用展示出相对于仅目标学习、简单合并和现有迁移方法的明显优势。

papers.title: SketchDirector: Complex Scene Sketching via Agentic Layout Reasoning and Detail Refinement
papers.translated_title: SketchDirector：通过智能体布局推理与细节精炼进行复杂场景素描
papers.author: Yiqi Liang
papers.summary: Existing sketch generation methods often rely on image guidance and are largely limited to individual objects or simplified scenes, leaving text-guided complex scene sketching underexplored. We present SketchDirector, an agentic framework that mimics the human sketching workflow for automatic multi-concept scene sketching. Given a scene-level text prompt, SketchDirector first employs a large language model~(LLM) to decompose the scene into multiple draft assets, where each is represented by a set of Bézier curves. Then, an agentic reasoning loop iteratively plans and executes their spatial arrangement, guided by self-evolving memory. Finally, a detail refinement module leverages diffusion priors to enhance sketch quality while preserving geometric structure. To support future research and applications in multi-concept scene sketch generation, we further introduce the \textit{MCSketch8K} dataset, comprising editable vector assets, compositional layouts, and object-level manipulation annotations. Extensive experiments show that SketchDirector outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in semantic and compositional quality while effectively preserving overall contour organization during refinement. The project page is: \href{https://yiki77.github.io/SketchDirector/}{https://yiki77.github.io/SketchDirector/}.
papers.translated_summary: 现有的草图生成方法通常依赖图像引导，且大多局限于单个物体或简化场景，导致文本引导的复杂场景草图生成研究不足。我们提出SketchDirector，一个模仿人类草图绘制流程的智能体框架，用于自动生成多概念场景草图。给定场景级文本提示，SketchDirector首先利用大语言模型（LLM）将场景分解为多个草稿素材，每个素材由一组贝塞尔曲线表示。随后，一个智能体推理循环在自演化记忆的引导下迭代地规划并执行它们的空间布局。最后，一个细节精修模块利用扩散先验来提升草图质量，同时保持几何结构。为支持多概念场景草图生成的未来研究与应用，我们进一步引入了MCSketch8K数据集，包含可编辑矢量素材、组合布局和物体级操作标注。大量实验表明，SketchDirector在语义和组合质量上优于最先进的基线方法，同时在精修过程中有效保持整体轮廓组织。项目页面为：https://yiki77.github.io/SketchDirector/。

papers.title: PBSR: Pseudo-Burst Super-Resolution via Zero-Shot Novel View Synthesis
papers.translated_title: PBSR：通过零样本新视角合成的伪爆发超分辨率
papers.author: Yuki Kondo
papers.summary: Burst super-resolution (BSR) achieves higher reconstruction fidelity than single-image super-resolution (SISR) by aggregating sub-pixel information from multiple frames. However, it requires a burst of frames captured under near-static conditions, and such frames are unavailable for single photographs or archival images. We propose Pseudo-Burst Super-Resolution (PBSR), which brings BSR-style reconstruction to the single-image input setting by synthesizing pseudo-burst frames via zero-shot novel view synthesis (NVS). PBSR first generates pseudo-burst frames with realistic parallax using a viewpoint sampling strategy calibrated to the pixel-shift distribution of real burst datasets. The frames are then processed by a BSR backbone equipped with a geometry-aware alignment module that reuses the NVS camera parameters and estimated depth. While the NVS stage is zero-shot, the backbone is fine-tuned with an artifact-aware adaptation so that it can exploit the synthesized frames despite their generative artifacts. Experiments on the BurstSR dataset show that PBSR consistently improves in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS over the single-frame baseline with the same reconstruction backbone.
papers.translated_summary: 爆发超分辨率（BSR）通过聚合多帧的亚像素信息，相比单图像超分辨率（SISR）实现了更高的重建保真度。然而，它需要一组在近静态条件下拍摄的帧，而单张照片或档案图像无法获得这样的帧。我们提出伪爆发超分辨率（PBSR），通过零样本新视角合成（NVS）合成伪爆发帧，将BSR风格的重建引入单图像输入设置。PBSR首先使用根据真实爆发数据集像素位移分布校准的视点采样策略，生成具有真实视差的伪爆发帧。随后，这些帧由配备几何感知对齐模块的BSR主干网络处理，该模块复用NVS相机参数和估计深度。虽然NVS阶段是零样本的，但主干网络通过伪影感知适配进行微调，使其能够利用合成帧，尽管这些帧存在生成伪影。在BurstSR数据集上的实验表明，PBSR在相同重建主干网络下，相比单帧基线在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS上均持续提升。

papers.title: ReVEAL: Eliciting Role-Aware Latent Visual Evidence from MLLMs for Reasoning Video Object Segmentation
papers.translated_title: ReVEAL：从多模态大语言模型中激发角色感知的潜在视觉证据以用于推理视频目标分割
papers.author: Zhongyuan Bao
papers.summary: Reasoning video object segmentation (ReVOS) requires segmenting the target specified by an implicit query throughout a video. Existing MLLM-based methods typically require costly cross-model alignment, tying MLLM training to a downstream segmentation model. We present ReVEAL, a decoupled thinking-with-video framework for ReVOS that elicits role-aware latent visual evidence from MLLM reasoning to directly guide segmentation. ReVEAL introduces Visual Evidence Tokens (VETs) into video reasoning to associate necessary visual regions or entities with target, background, or distractor roles, while a Dynamic Attention Layer Router adaptively aggregates VET-to-video attention across layers into role-specific grounding evidence. We train the MLLM to perform VET-augmented reasoning on our constructed ReVEAL-47K dataset, with a Contrastive Attention Grounding Loss as auxiliary supervision to apply role-specific constraints to VET attention and optimize layer routing for reliable latent grounding. At inference, ReVEAL identifies the target through this thinking-with-video process and fuses the resulting role-specific evidence to guide a frozen SAM2 in predicting target masks. Experiments on five benchmarks show that ReVEAL outperforms alignment-free baselines and remains competitive with alignment-based methods.
papers.translated_summary: 推理视频目标分割（ReVOS）需要在整段视频中分割由隐式查询指定的目标。现有的基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的方法通常需要昂贵的跨模型对齐，将 MLLM 训练与下游分割模型绑定。我们提出 ReVEAL，一种用于 ReVOS 的解耦式“以视频思考”框架，从 MLLM 推理中引出角色感知的潜在视觉证据，以直接引导分割。ReVEAL 将视觉证据 token（VET）引入视频推理，将必要的视觉区域或实体与目标、背景或干扰物角色相关联，同时动态注意力层路由器自适应地聚合跨层的 VET 到视频注意力，形成角色特定的定位证据。我们在构建的 ReVEAL-47K 数据集上训练 MLLM 执行 VET 增强推理，并以对比注意力定位损失作为辅助监督，对 VET 注意力施加角色特定约束，并优化层路由以获得可靠的潜在定位。在推理时，ReVEAL 通过这一“以视频思考”过程识别目标，并融合所得的角色特定证据，以引导冻结的 SAM2 预测目标掩码。在五个基准上的实验表明，ReVEAL 优于无需对齐的基线，并与基于对齐的方法保持竞争力。

papers.title: Hawkeye: Reading Illegible Text with Vision Language Models
papers.translated_title: Hawkeye：利用视觉语言模型读取难以辨认的文本
papers.author: Brian Tang
papers.summary: While modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have been remarkably successful in general scene text recognition, they consistently struggle with the long-tail distribution of text that is degraded by motion blur or low resolution. These limitations are particularly apparent in egocentric applications like smart glasses, where text is often captured in noisy environments. In this paper, we introduce the \textbf{BSTRB} (Blurry Scene Text Recognition Benchmark), a novel benchmark of 8,398 noisy image samples with high-fidelity annotations derived from 1,699 real-world video sequences. To support this, we present \textbf{Hawkeye}, a VLM fine-tuned on BSTRB to read and reason about illegible text by leveraging contextual priors and pixel-level alignment. Our results show that \name matches much larger VLMs on BSTRB overall and exceeds them on text at or below 20 pixels, in a single pass suited to real-time deployment. We characterize the resolution at which current VLMs begin to fail.
papers.translated_summary: 尽管现代视觉语言模型（VLM）在通用场景文本识别方面取得了显著成功，但它们在处理因运动模糊或低分辨率而退化的长尾分布文本时始终表现不佳。这些局限在智能眼镜等自我中心应用中尤为明显，此类场景中的文本往往在噪声环境中被捕获。本文中，我们提出了 BSTRB（模糊场景文本识别基准），这是一个包含 8,398 个噪声图像样本、具有高保真标注的新基准，其数据源自 1,699 段真实世界视频序列。为支撑该基准，我们提出了 Hawkeye，一个在 BSTRB 上微调的 VLM，通过利用上下文先验和像素级对齐来读取和推理难以辨认的文本。我们的结果表明，Hawkeye 在 BSTRB 上总体表现与规模更大的 VLM 相当，并在 20 像素及以下的文本上超越它们，且以适合实时部署的单次推理完成。我们刻画了当前 VLM 开始失效的分辨率阈值。

papers.title: Stochastic Mirror Descent under Dependent Observations
papers.translated_title: 依赖观测下的随机镜像下降
papers.author: Gersende Fort
papers.summary: We study the non-asymptotic convergence of Stochastic Mirror Descent (SMD) algorithm when the noisy first-order oracle is driven by dependent observations. Departing from the classical i.i.d. assumption underlying most existing guarantees, we introduce a flexible ``forgetting" condition that accommodates geometrically or polynomially dependent sequences. Under this condition we derive explicit finite-sample accuracy bounds for the averaged SMD iterates, recovering the classical $O(1/T)$ and $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ rates in the large- and small-initial-error regimes. We instantiate the general framework on two applications: high-dimensional linear regression with dependent regressors and nonparametric estimation of the drift function of a functional autoregressive model.
papers.translated_summary: 我们研究当噪声一阶预言机由相依观测驱动时，随机镜像下降（SMD）算法的非渐近收敛性。不同于大多数现有保证所依赖的经典独立同分布假设，我们引入一个灵活的“遗忘”条件，以容纳几何或多项式相依序列。在该条件下，我们为平均SMD迭代推导出显式的有限样本精度界，并在大初始误差和小初始误差情形下恢复经典的$O(1/T)$和$O(1/\sqrt{T})$速率。我们将该一般框架应用于两个实例：具有相依回归变量的高维线性回归，以及函数自回归模型漂移函数的非参数估计。

papers.title: MEMIG: Self-evolving Memory Construction for Antibody Optimization
papers.translated_title: MEMIG：用于抗体优化的自演化记忆构建
papers.author: Yunhui Jang
papers.summary: Memory has become central to self-evolving LLM agents, which store and retrieve experience from past rollouts to guide future decisions. Existing systems represent this experience as free-form natural language and maintain it by rewriting, which fits tasks whose experience is narratable. However, in scientific discovery and optimization, experience is often a quantity measured by an oracle under a specific context. Rewriting it as text leaves no index for where a record should be, replaces a measurement with a description, and cannot express how interventions interact. To address this, we argue that agent memory for biomolecule optimization should instead be indexable, quantitative, and structured, and we introduce MEMIG. This memory construction framework realizes these three properties. In detail, MEMIG addresses each insight with a domain-grounded identifier and accumulates the quantitative effect measured by a property oracle, so that updates remain local and retrieval becomes an exact lookup. Next, MEMIG connects insights whose interventions are applied together and measures their epistasis by decomposing each evaluated set. Our results show that MEMIG improves performance in most settings across in silico antibody optimization tasks.
papers.translated_summary: 记忆已成为自演化大语言模型智能体的核心，这些智能体从过去的 rollout 中存储和检索经验以指导未来决策。现有系统将这种经验表示为自由形式的自然语言，并通过重写来维护，这适合经验可叙述的任务。然而，在科学发现与优化中，经验往往是由 oracle 在特定情境下测量的量。将其重写为文本会失去记录应处位置的索引，用描述替代测量，且无法表达干预之间如何相互作用。为解决这一问题，我们认为面向生物分子优化的智能体记忆应当是可按索引访问的、定量的和结构化的，并提出了 MEMIG。这一记忆构建框架实现了上述三个特性。具体而言，MEMIG 用领域锚定的标识符处理每条洞见，并累积由性质 oracle 测量的定量效应，从而使更新保持局部化、检索成为精确查找。接下来，MEMIG 连接那些干预被一起应用的洞见，并通过分解每个评估集来测量其上位效应。我们的结果表明，MEMIG 在计算机抗体优化任务的多数设置中提升了性能。
